image_description: A top-down view of a black hockey puck on a white background. The puck has a matte texture with some visible wear or scuff marks. A rectangular white label is adhered to the center of the top face, containing distorted, illegible text that resembles 'BRUINS' but is structurally nonsensical. The side ridges of the puck are partially visible at the bottom edge where the label does not cover them.
